'''Antoine (PM-08)'''<ref>[[The Whitespring Resort terminal entries#Week of 10/11/77|The Whitespring Resort terminal entries; Maintenance room terminal, Maintenance Logs; Week of 10/11/77]]</ref> is a [[Protectron (Fallout 76)|Protectron]] serving as a [[Fallout 76 vendors|vendor]] at [[the Whitespring Resort|Whitespring Mall]] in [[Appalachia]].            

==Background==
Antoine is one of the robotic vendors that replaced the human staff of the Whitespring shortly before the [[Great War]].<ref>[[The Whitespring 2080 Initiative]]</ref> He is the automated head chef of Le Grand Gourmet in the Whitespring Resort and has a wide variety of recipes for sale. He staffs the store along with [[Marie (Fallout 76)|Marie]].
